name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: In the Hillsbrad Foothills, the Forsaken move against the humans resisting their advance. High Executor Darthalia orders the smithy in Hillsbrad Fields destroyed, hoping to cut off the weapons arming the local people.

sections.title: Breaking the Anvil
sections.body: The Forsaken meet fiercer resistance in the Hillsbrad Foothills than High Executor Darthalia expected. Rural humans refuse to scatter or yield to the Deathstalkers and soldiers sent from Tarren Mill. The Forsaken learn that the peasantry are not fighting with pitchforks and scythes alone. In the fields, they are being armed for war.

sections.title: Severing the Supply Line
sections.body: At the southwest edge of Hillsbrad Fields, Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices forge blades and armor for the militia from raw ore. Darthalia sends an operative to kill Verringtan, butcher his apprentices, and seize their stockpiled iron shipment. She aims to weaken the settlement's defense and use the metal in the eventual assault on Southshore.

faq.q: Why does High Executor Darthalia target the blacksmith specifically?
faq.answer: The human townsfolk and farmers are resisting the Forsaken advance with arms. Darthalia learns that Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices are forging weapons for the militia, arming the peasants.
The smithy is on the southwestern side of Hillsbrad Fields, where apprentices work amid guards and local patrols.

faq.q: What is the shipment of iron used for?
faq.answer: Darthalia takes the iron to supply the Forsaken war effort. She plans to forge weapons and supplies for the assault on Southshore.

faq.q: How does this fit into the broader Battle of Hillsbrad campaign?
faq.answer: The strike is the third stage in Darthalia's effort to dismantle the human presence in the foothills. After culling rural laborers and farmers, she turns to their leadership, logistics, and production.

faq.q: Are the people in Hillsbrad Fields part of the Alliance military?
faq.answer: The people in Hillsbrad Fields are mainly local farmers, laborers, and townsfolk, not Alliance soldiers. Though aligned with Southshore and the Alliance, they have formed an ad hoc militia to defend their homes from the Forsaken.
High Executor Darthalia orders the strike. She commands Forsaken operations from Tarren Mill.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know breaking the human smithy can help secure Lordaeron's southern borders and stockpile metal for your struggling war effort.
As an Alliance member, you know Verringtan's slaughter and the theft of the settlement's iron leave Southshore's outlying farms without their only means of self-defense.
As a blacksmith, you know Verringtan's forge fueled local resistance. An anvil can threaten an invading army as much as a regiment of footmen.
